scope: Fixed 1h and 6h replays of supplied 15m prices, aggregated only from complete observed buckets. Overlapping prices are not additional independent evidence. Each study has its own $500 simulated account. No new external candles were downloaded.
source_scope_note: The replay source hash predates two orchestration-only changes: automatic studies retain the selected lookback, and 6h models are restricted to research with forward monitoring support removed. This offline script calls learn_history directly; its learning/execution modules, DEFAULTS, data, costs and interval aggregation are unchanged. Final orchestration is regression-tested separately.
